candidates.title: macOS: recover from the first failed review load

metadata.scope: Only the revised initial-load failure recovery; original v001 source/map/focus and maintenance decisions remain accepted for their bound candidate. Not clean-account, vault, full-card or matrix acceptance.

criteria: When the first pull-request load fails, does Home clearly show the failure and a usable next step instead of leaving an empty Overview?
candidates.content: This is the actual tests-disabled universal app in a fresh disposable HOME. Unlock the Mac, run the command, and before choosing either sign-in or GitHub CLI paste the supplied synthetic pull-request link and press Return. This deliberately repeats the ordering that exposed the bug: without CLI selection the native anonymous reader asks github.com for the synthetic repository and is expected to receive 404 (a network refusal also exercises the same recovery). It is a read-only request, not local fixture data or authentication. Expected: Home reappears, the refusal and Copy details are visible, and the Open bar and sign-in/CLI choices are available. The accepted-destination contract still clears submitted text; paste again to retry. Judge only whether that recovery is clear and usable. Quit with Command-Q before the five-minute bound. Do not sign in, add a server, or open another repository. If the load unexpectedly succeeds, report that rather than accepting a failure you did not see. The earlier two human accepts remain unchanged; this does not approve clean-account authentication, Keychain or purge.

launch.label: Launch the isolated recovery candidate (five-minute bound)

copy.label: Synthetic link to open before choosing GitHub CLI
